initial_failure: A successfully continued native checkpoint remained eligible for startup resumption again.
fix: Startup selection excludes runs with a same-tenant recorded continuation; charging rechecks this condition to reject stale selections.
positive_controls: The latest cancelled or running continuation remains selectable when it has its own checkpoint. Completed latest work is not selected.
limits: Prevents replay of an original after a continuation record exists. Concurrent first admissions before either writes a continuation record are not made mutually exclusive by this change.
